lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition U2Mn10Ge2 (U(Mn5Ge)2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Ge and Mn centers each have 12 geometric neighbors, while U centers have 20, with Mn environments spanning distances of roughly 2.52–3.15 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ge and Mn 12-vertex polyhedra, corner- and edge-sharing among Mn polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ge and U polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
